description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Extension' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Startup' namespace. The class is responsible for setting up and registering extensions in the OpenCart catalog system during startup, including loading extension models, registering autoloaders for controllers, models, system libraries, and adding template, language, and config paths for extensions and OCMODs.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Handles the registration and setup of extensions during the startup process in the OpenCart catalog system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads extension data from the database, registers autoloaders for each extension, and adds template, language, and configuration paths for extension resources and OCMOD files.
